scope: Typed Entry Fabric causal event identity for HCU routing and downstream inference receipts

current_implementation_scope.law: Current Python-local deterministic hashes remain legacy implementation-scoped until a newly versioned RFC8785 identity is wired and admitted. Existing receipts retain their original identity schema and are never silently reinterpreted.

required_input_constraints: duplicate object property names rejected at raw ingress before ordinary Mapping construction can erase them
all strings are valid Unicode and lone surrogates fail closed
string contents are preserved as-is with no Unicode normalization performed by the canonicalization layer
JSON numbers are finite and representable as IEEE-754 binary64; NaN and Infinity fail closed
higher-precision integer application values do not silently exceed the I-JSON-safe identity domain
required_serialization: JSON primitive serialization follows RFC 8785 ECMAScript-compatible rules
object properties sort recursively by raw property-name UTF-16 code units
array element order is preserved while objects inside arrays are recursively canonicalized

alternative_candidate_adjudication.hcu_causal_canonical_v1.py: RETAIN_RESEARCH_PROVENANCE_ONLY_NOT_ADMITTED; custom typed binary identity would require a separate bespoke interoperability contract and is not selected over the already-specified RFC8785 path
alternative_candidate_adjudication.typed_entry_canonical_v1.py: RETAIN_RESEARCH_PROVENANCE_ONLY_NOT_ADMITTED; deterministic CBOR subset rejects float-valued reactive signals and is not selected as the single end-to-end event-route canonicalizer

remaining_gates_before_cross_language_pr: wire the selected RFC8785 implementation into Entry event, router policy, engine and route identity under new versioned schemas
bind canonicalization schema/version into downstream inference receipts
reject duplicate-property raw JSON before Mapping construction
run exact-source isolated branch regressions after wiring
independently compare the exact admitted event through at least two implementations/languages
rebuild the package snapshot only after canonicalization semantics settle
note: This selects one interoperability candidate without creating a second state, routing, truth, recovery, or effect authority. Source/prototype conformance does not establish exact EntityOS/HCU runtime acceptance.
